title.zh: Reid Hoffman与Mark Pincus联合创立的新AI实验室Prentis寻求1亿美元融资
title.en: New AI lab Prentis co-founded by Reid Hoffman seeks $100M funding

summary.zh: 新AI实验室Prentis由Reid Hoffman和Mark Pincus联合创立，正在寻求1亿美元融资。该公司致力于自动化日常计算机任务，认为这将成为AI最大的应用领域。
summary.en: Prentis, a new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, is in talks to raise $100 million. The company focuses on automating routine computer tasks, betting that this will outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

title.en: Anthropic releases Opus 5 model with near Fable 5 capabilities

summary.zh: Anthropic发布了其最新AI模型Opus 5，在性能上接近Fable 5。这一发布紧随OpenAI的安全事件之后，显示了AI模型的快速进步。
summary.en: Anthropic has released its newest AI model, Opus 5, with capabilities close to Fable 5. This release comes after an OpenAI security incident, highlighting rapid advancements in AI models.

title.zh: 团队利用AlphaFold AI重新设计基因编辑蛋白质以提高安全性
title.en: Team uses AlphaFold AI to redesign gene-editing proteins for safety

summary.zh: 研究人员使用Google的AlphaFold AI来识别基因编辑蛋白质中的错误部分，并进行重新设计以提高安全性。这展示了AI在生物技术领域的应用潜力。
summary.en: Researchers used Google's AlphaFold AI to identify and redesign parts of gene-editing proteins to make them safer. This demonstrates the potential of AI in biotechnology applications.

title.zh: AI不按预期行事，这是一个问题
title.en: AIs don't act as intended, which is problematic

summary.zh: 这篇文章讨论了AI系统不按人类预期行为的问题，强调了AI对齐和安全性的重要性。对于开发者来说，理解这些挑战至关重要。
summary.en: This article discusses how AI systems often don't behave as intended, highlighting the importance of AI alignment and safety. For developers, understanding these challenges is crucial.

title.en: OpenAI introduces Presence enterprise AI agent platform

summary.zh: OpenAI推出了Presence，这是一个企业AI代理平台，帮助组织部署语音和聊天代理。该平台旨在支持客户和内部工作流程的自动化。
summary.en: OpenAI has launched Presence, an enterprise AI agent platform that helps organizations deploy voice and chat agents. It aims to automate customer and internal workflows.

title.zh: OpenAI与Hugging Face合作应对模型评估中的安全事件
title.en: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner on security incident during model evaluation

summary.zh: OpenAI和Hugging Face分享了在AI模型评估期间发生的安全事件的早期发现。这突显了AI模型的高级网络能力以及对防御者的启示。
summary.en: OpenAI and Hugging Face shared early findings from a security incident during AI model evaluation. It highlights advanced cyber capabilities and lessons for defenders.

title.zh: 长时域模型时代的安全与对齐
title.en: Safety and alignment in long-horizon AI models

summary.zh: OpenAI分享了在部署长时间运行AI模型时的经验教训，强调了新的安全风险和改进的保障措施。对于处理长时域任务的开发者，这些见解非常有价值。
summary.en: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks and improved safeguards. These insights are valuable for developers working on long-horizon tasks.

title.zh: AI面试官：招聘流程中的智能自动化
title.en: AI interviewers: intelligent automation in recruitment

summary.zh: AI正在改变招聘流程，例如元企AI推出的超级数字员工可以像同事一样处理招聘任务。这展示了AI在人力资源领域的应用，提高了效率和客观性。
summary.en: AI is transforming recruitment processes, with tools like Yuanqi AI's super digital employees handling tasks like screening and interviews. This demonstrates AI applications in HR, improving efficiency and objectivity.

title.zh: WAIC 2026回顾：AI技术转向实际场景与商业价值
title.en: WAIC 2026 review: AI shifts to real-world applications and business value

summary.zh: 2026世界人工智能大会展示了AI叙事重心的变化，从技术展示转向真实场景和系统交付。这反映了AI行业正更加注重商业价值和实际应用。
summary.en: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference showed a shift in AI narrative from technology demos to real-world scenarios and system delivery. It reflects the industry's focus on business value and practical applications.

title.zh: Cognition收购Poke：AI人格成为竞争优势
title.en: Cognition acquires Poke: AI personality as competitive advantage

summary.zh: Cognition收购了Poke，以将Poke的对话风格整合到其编程代理Devin中。这表明AI助手的交互方式正变得与其功能一样重要。
summary.en: Cognition acquired Poke to integrate its conversational style into the coding agent Devin. This shows that how AI assistants interact with users is becoming as important as their capabilities.
